map.为什么内容越长码越密？: Why does longer content make the code denser?
map.二维码容量按「版本」分级：内容越长需要的码字越多，版本越高、模块数越多、单个模块: QR capacity is graded by version: longer content needs more codewords, a higher version, more modules, and smaller individual modules, so long content is harder to scan at the same print size. Practical tips: shorten content first (use a short link), lower correction from H to M, and increase print size with version.
